thread:
rachel: Publishing the RCA for the fallback cascade that increased latencies for a subset of customers this morning. Internal doc: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.com/pm/1842156789 (internal).
postmortem-bot: Postmortem uploaded and indexed. Timeline, root cause, and mitigations populated. :robot_face:
mike: TL;DR — an unexpected fallback chain triggered when a new model variant returned a 429 spike; fallback routing attempted multiple lower-capacity pools causing queueing and elevated tail latency for ~22 minutes.
anya-cto: Thanks. Please add a one-paragraph executive summary and a board-facing slide in the doc.
rachel: Copied key action items here. Please ACK and update ETAs inline.

- ACTION-101 | Owner: mike    | Add rate-limit spike detector and short-circuit fallback logic | Due: 2026-03-31
- ACTION-102 | Owner: infra   | Harden fallback routing to respect pool capacity and concurrency caps | Due: 2026-04-04
- ACTION-103 | Owner: oncall  | Create alert for cascading fallback activity and add paging rule | Due: 2026-03-29
- ACTION-104 | Owner: cs      | Draft proactive customer comms for affected tenants and review with legal | Due: 2026-03-28
- CHECKPOINT   | All owners    | Post status update in the doc by EOD 2026-03-27

infra: Ill add a canary that simulates 429 spikes and verify fallback behavior in staging.
oncall: Adding alert + paging rule now. Will test in staging and tag oncall once enabled.
cs: Will prepare a short, factual note for affected tenants; sending draft to legal and pm for signoff.
mike: Ill open the PR for short-circuit logic today and include unit tests + an integration test that simulates capacity saturation. PR: https://github.com/redwood/serving/pull/6033
rachel: Follow-up meeting scheduled: 2026-04-06 09:30 PT. Invite and doc link in the postmortem. If you cant make it, drop a short update in the doc. Closing publish notification here. :white_check_mark:
